file_roles.evidence: Diff changes cleanRemovedTasksCalledByCleanerThread to iterate listNonEmptyTaskDirectories() instead of listAllTaskDirectories(), so emptied dirs are not revisited.

rationale: The repeated 'Deleting obsolete state directory' message comes from the cleaner re-processing empty task directories. The loop selection in the same method is changed to skip empty ones. The wrong iteration set is the defect.
